prompt: Implement wrap(text, width) in wrap.py: return the text wrapped to lines of at most `width` characters, breaking only at spaces, with no trailing spaces on a line. Runs of spaces between words count as one. A word longer than `width` is split into pieces of exactly `width` (the last may be shorter). Paragraphs (separated by a blank line) stay separated by exactly one blank line; a single newline inside a paragraph is a space. Return the lines joined by "\n".
